text:
Explicit limited structural revision of the unexecuted data-adaptation composition. Preserve every accepted requirement and public input/output contract exactly, including non-null products, nullable required fact fields, products minItems=0/maxItems=10, productsFile from the actual writer, query, first products in observed order and repeated selections. Preserve required search navigation, each product visit, the authorized writer destination and root cleanup. No unrequested actions, filtering, deduplication or invented rows/data. Do not alter limits, operations' permissions, or add a framework.

Fix extract_product_links: it currently binds the whole observationSnapshot, has no each, and mixes extraction with selecting ten products. Bind complete observationSnapshot.pages with existing typed fields and explicit each whose input exactly names the bound pages. Emit one compact Candidate[] per original page, with assembled resultType array<array<Candidate>>; every page is processed, no top-ten truncation inside mapping. Keep full observations separately. Each candidate contains its verbatim observed reference ID and only decision facts. Flatten exactly one level into a genuine global decision selecting IDs only, at most the first ten products under the accepted requirement. Assert lookup against offered candidates first in the consuming task's local requires, then resolve unchanged IDs against original observed records for navigation. Use one necessary typed per-page record projection before flatten where existing bindings require it; never field on an array. No shortening IDs or regenerating action URLs.

Fix open_product_page and extract_product_detail: use observation_complete, not capped HTML, for every visited page. Keep authoritative successful/acquisition-completeness predicates local to consuming tasks and tied to original producer metadata; no model-declared success/completeness flags. Independent extraction processes every complete page and produces only compact observed candidates/facts. Genuine decisions receive only compact views, never the raw snapshot or unrelated action data alongside them. A description is one complete original observed block copied verbatim. If choosing the block needs judgment, select its unchanged ID then lookup its original text. Preserve exact name and price values, null for permitted missing facts, and only actual observed errors; interface affordances do not prove an error and missing fields do not authorize invented explanatory text.

Replace finalize_products and build_xlsx_rows interpretations with existing value/field/object/array bindings, scope exports and a minimal typed projection only where needed. Keep a checked bounded product/row projection when required to preserve public cardinality. Assemble the structured XLSX rows deterministically; headers are a literal supplied row, null cells stay blank, exact whitespace and row order survive. Do not invent a synthetic product row when search failed. Producer failure or incomplete observations must fail before affected work and still allow the existing cleanup. Return productsFile only from the successful writer output. Keep the small initial query-to-search-URL conversion only if existing bindings cannot express URL encoding safely; do not add new UI actions just to replace it.

You may add/remove data-adaptation tasks and their direct bindings/exports, and change the existing product observation format/inputs for complete capture. Keep external business work, accepted interfaces, scope correctness, local requires and failure ordering. Use only the existing inspected contracts and TaskPlan vocabulary; emit no JavaScript. Keep pure copying out of inference and keep the revised plan compact. Return the complete revised proposal through the existing revision mechanism.
